hook: The best-converting price can lose money.

beats.say: In October twenty twenty-six, Airbnb began rolling out a dynamic pricing tool that previews recommended prices and responds to local demand.
At a hundred dollars, a Barcelona apartment books eighty-five percent of the time. At a hundred ninety, only forty-two percent, yet the middle price earns most.
A team rewarded only for conversion could optimize toward a worse outcome, because every prediction carries a financial cost.
